name: @sand/thread-list
description: Lists threads and unsent drafts in the nav host, and adds threads, projects and thread actions to the palette

sand.label: Thread list
sand.summary: Your threads and unsent drafts in the sidebar, and threads and projects in the palette

uses.nav: shows a plain thread switcher at the top
uses.composer: new thread does not focus the prompt
uses.palette: threads and projects are not searchable, and New thread starts in the current folder
uses.projects: only the current folder is offered for a new thread, and projects cannot be renamed or hidden
uses.picker: projects cannot be renamed from the palette, and threads cannot be renamed from their menu without the palette
uses.syncFlows: a project with no copy on this PC starts on another PC instead of offering to clone or sync it
uses.machines: threads from other PCs show no PC name
uses.drafts: unsent new threads are not listed
uses.jobs: threads whose background agents are still running look idle
uses.branches: threads show their folder instead of their git branch
